cases.sentence: Бородинское сражение с последовавшими за ним занятием Москвы и бегством французов, без ___ — есть одно из самых поучительных явлений истории.
cases.explain: «новых сражений» — after the preposition «без», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The Battle of Borodinó, with the occupation of Moscow that followed it and the flight of the French without further conflicts, is one of the most instructive phenomena in history.

cases.sentence: Бородинское сражение с последовавшими за ним занятием Москвы и бегством французов, без новых сражений — есть одно из самых ___ истории.
cases.explain: «поучительных явлений» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The Battle of Borodinó, with the occupation of Moscow that followed it and the flight of the French without further conflicts, is one of the most instructive phenomena in history.

cases.sentence: Так было (по истории) с древнейших времен и до ___.
cases.explain: «настоящего времени» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So according to history it has been found from the most ancient times, and so it is to our own day. All Napoleon’s wars serve to confirm this rule. In proportion to the defeat of the Austrian army Austria loses its rights, and the rights and the strength of France increase. The victories of the French at Jena and Auerstädt destroy the independent existence of Prussia.

cases.sentence: По степени поражения ___, Австрия лишается своих прав, и увеличиваются права и силы Франции.
cases.explain: «австрийских войск» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So according to history it has been found from the most ancient times, and so it is to our own day. All Napoleon’s wars serve to confirm this rule. In proportion to the defeat of the Austrian army Austria loses its rights, and the rights and the strength of France increase. The victories of the French at Jena and Auerstädt destroy the independent existence of Prussia.

cases.sentence: Но вдруг в 1812-м году французами одержана победа под Москвой, Москва взята, и вслед за тем без ___ не Россия перестала существовать, а перестала существовать 600-тысячная армия, потом наполеоновская Франция.
cases.explain: «новых сражений» — after the preposition «без», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But then, in 1812, the French gain a victory near Moscow. Moscow is taken and after that, with no further battles, it is not Russia that ceases to exist, but the French army of six hundred thousand, and then Napoleonic France itself. To strain the facts to fit the rules of history: to say that the field of battle at Borodinó remained in the hands of the Russians, or that after Moscow there were other battles that destroyed Napoleon’s army, is impossible.

cases.sentence: После Бородинской победы французов, не было ни одного не только генерального, но сколько-нибудь ___, и французская армия перестала существовать.
cases.explain: «значительного сражения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: After the French victory at Borodinó there was no general engagement nor any that were at all serious, yet the French army ceased to exist. What does this mean? If it were an example taken from the history of China, we might say that it was not an historic phenomenon (which is the historians’ usual expedient when anything does not fit their standards); if the matter concerned some brief conflict in which only a small number of troops took part, we might treat it as an exception; but this event occurred before our fathers’ eyes, and for them it was a question of the life or death of their fatherland, and it happened in the greatest of all known wars.

cases.sentence: Со времени пожара Смоленска началась война, не подходящая ни под какие ___ войн.
cases.explain: «прежние предания» — after the preposition «под», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: After the burning of Smolénsk a war began which did not follow any previous traditions of war. The burning of towns and villages, the retreats after battles, the blow dealt at Borodinó and the renewed retreat, the burning of Moscow, the capture of marauders, the seizure of transports, and the guerrilla war were all departures from the rules.
